review.why: Creates sales collateral reps will use: decks, one-pagers, objection docs, battle cards, win-loss analysis, demo scripts, proposals and playbooks.
review.summary: Principles: involve reps, tailor to the situation, stay scannable, tie to outcomes and write only claims reps can defend. It then gives structures for decks, one-pagers, objection docs, a live-deal objection method, battle cards, win-loss coding with counts, ROI calculators, demo scripts, case study briefs, proposals and persona cards.
strengths: Claims reps can defend: evidence for why we win and honest notes on where we lose
Live-deal objection method gives one answer the rep can say as written
Win-loss method reports counts with sample sizes and includes wins
cautions: Battle cards need verified, dated competitor facts that someone must maintain
Six reference files with scripts and templates are not read here
